scope.summary: Implement body soft-tissue regions in tailor-solver (spec 13.20; REQ-028, PREQ-017): volume-preserving XPBD soft-body on low-res region cages (breasts L/R, glutes L/R, belly) driving the base-mesh surface via cage deformation, as a SoftBodySpec extension living in the SAME solver world and stepper as cloth - explicitly no forked solver.
acceptance_criteria: SoftBodySpec extended with body region cages: a low-res cage per region generated from MT-486 region masks, simulated as volume-preserving XPBD (per-cell volume constraints) inside the existing cloth solver world/stepper - no separate simulation loop.
Cage-to-surface binding drives the base mesh via cage/harmonic-coordinate deformation; binding re-derives automatically on channel-state change so morphs and soft tissue compose.
Volume preservation proven: cage volume deviation under a gravity settle stays within the documented tolerance.
Region isolation: soft-tissue deformation writes only within its declared region mask (decouple-law compliant, BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID clean).
scope.risk_if_missed: Daz has no soft body at all, making this a headline differentiator (REQ-028); forking a separate solver world instead of extending the cloth XPBD world would double maintenance forever and make unified body-cloth-prop collision (MT-540) structurally impossible.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Keep one solver world but separate tissue constitutive models, require two-way contact for final quality, and reuse the new checkpoint/contact/receipt gates.
Reconcile preview cages with final nonlinear tissue, inversion barriers, full shared contacts, accepted checkpoints, and reference motion scenes.
